rows.abstract: Prescribes the conditions for a political party or sectoral party to be registered --- (1) That the party's constituency is spread over the geographical terriroty of at least a majority of the regions; (2) That the sectoral party can show proof thatit represents the interest and concerns of at least 300,000 Filipino citizens belonging to the sector it seeks to represent.
